story:
Ethan loved his big red truck more than almost anything. [emotion:QT/happy] Before breakfast, he would race it across the kitchen floor while Dad made toast.

One morning, the truck's chunky front wheel cracked right off. [emotion:QT/sad] Ethan felt his chest go heavy, like a rock had dropped inside it.

"Dad, the wheel broke," Ethan said quietly, showing him the three pieces.

Dad crouched down. "Maybe we can fix it together. You hold the parts, and I'll get the glue."

While Ethan held the pieces carefully, Dad pressed them back into place. [emotion:QT/calm] Ethan watched every move.

"Which part goes there?" Dad asked, pointing to the round edge.

"That one," Ethan said, sliding the piece forward.

After the glue dried, the truck rolled smoothly again. Ethan thought it looked even better than before, because they had fixed it together. [emotion:QT/happy] Dad ruffled his hair and said, "Best repair crew in the whole house."

Ethan grinned and drove the red truck three laps around the table. [emotion:QT/happy][gesture:emotions/hoora]

questions.question: What is the main message of this story about Ethan and his red truck?
questions.correct_answer: Working together can make things better
wrong_answers: Trucks are the best toys to race
Broken things should be thrown away

questions.question: Before breakfast, where was Ethan racing his red truck while Dad made toast?
After the glue dried, what did Ethan do with his truck that showed he was happy again?
questions.correct_answer: He drove it three laps around the table
wrong_answers: He raced it through three rooms
He gave the truck to his dad

questions.question: Why do you think Ethan thought the truck looked even better than before, even though it had been broken?
questions.correct_answer: Because he and his dad fixed it together
wrong_answers: Because the glue made it shinier and faster
Because Dad bought him three new wheels

questions.question: How do you think Ethan felt when the chunky wheel cracked right off his favourite truck?
questions.correct_answer: Sad and heavy-hearted, like something was wrong
wrong_answers: Thrilled because he could get a new truck
Calm because he knew how to fix it

questions.question: Why was it a good idea for Ethan to tell his dad about the broken truck?
questions.correct_answer: Asking for help means you are smart enough to know you do not have to do everything alone.
wrong_answers: Telling a grown-up about your problems means they will always fix everything for you right away.
Asking for help is only a good idea when something is too big or too heavy for you to carry.

questions.question: What did Ethan and his dad show us by what they did?
questions.correct_answer: Working together with someone you love makes hard things feel easier.
wrong_answers: Fixing things at home is always faster and better than buying something brand new.
Spending time with family is most important when you are feeling bored or have nothing to do.

questions.question: What is one lesson from this story?
questions.correct_answer: Trying again after something breaks is how you make things better.
wrong_answers: Taking very good care of your toys means they will never get broken or damaged.
When something stops working, the best thing to do is wait until you feel ready to use it again.

takeaways: Asking for help means you are smart enough to know you do not have to do everything alone.
Working together with someone you love makes hard things feel easier.
Trying again after something breaks is how you make things better.
